messages:
devon: Heads-up — prototyping a "slim" preset routing flow for console per-route views. Want the routing policy + saved-view handshake to carry telemetry tags so analytics can break down by model variant. anyone around for a quick sync?

marta: I'm tied up for the rest of today but quick q: do you want presets to be tied to route-id only or route+model? if it's route-only we lose per-model metrics for model-aware filters.

raj: prefer route+model tuple. telemetry needs distinct tags (route, model, variant) to correlate latency/cost. otherwise downstream evals can't tell which model caused regressions.

devon: yeah — route+model makes sense for telemetry. downside: quota/preview UX — we currently show per-route token burn. splitting by model means per-model estimates in the preview. thoughts on UX?

marta: show stacked token burn in the preview: base route cost + model delta. UI-wise keep legacy savedviews as route-only; new savedviews created from route+model pin will include model metadata. easy migration path.

raj: also need rollout policy fields so console can recommend cheaper variant but fallback to higher-perf one if latency SLOs are missed. something like: "policy": {"preference": ["cost","latency"], "fallbacks": ["variantA","variantB"]}

devon: sketching an API contract. quick draft: 
```json
{
  "preset_id": "slim_telemetry_01",
  "scope": {"route_id": "r-123", "model": "gpt-x-small"},
  "preview": {"estimated_tokens": 2345, "estimated_cost": 0.045},
  "policy": {"preference": ["latency","cost"], "fallback": ["gpt-x-medium"]},
  "telemetry_tags": ["route:r-123","model:gpt-x-small","variant:quant4x"],
  "sampling_rate": 0.01
}
```

marta: add `cache_effect_adjustment` to preview so we don't double-count prefix hits from KV cache. otherwise previews will overshoot. and add a sanity upper bound for sampling_rate.

raj: good call. also emit `preview_basis` tag (e.g., historical-traffic vs synthetic) so billing comparisons are apples-to-apples.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy for console-presets-api scheduled: 2025-06-03T18:00:00Z (team: eng-platform).

devon: thanks — I'll wire up a mock UI with stacked token bars + small info tooltip for `cache_effect_adjustment`. syncing Tue 10:00am PT to finalize API contract, rollout knobs, and telemetry keys.

marta: :thumbsup: I'll add a docs stub under console/docs/presets and put sample queries for telemetry analysts.

raj: I can add the tracing hooks to ensure we tag calls with variant metadata end-to-end.

devon: sweet. leaving this thread here — ping if you want to pair before Tues.
